20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yomahluko “wokuvuka” “nokubilisa” xa kubilisiwe amanzi epanini?
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Ukuvuka yinto apho iimolekyuli zomphezulu wolwelo ziguquka zibe yigesi ngaphantsi kwendawo yokubila, ize ukubila libe yimeko apho kufikelelwe kwindawo yokubila ize igesi yenziwe ngamandla ingekho kumphezulu kuphela kodwa nangaphakathi konke.

20261122-chemistry-g04-1.s.s1.prompt: [Utshintsho lwemeko olunzulu] Amanzi afakwe kwi-beaker aza ashushu abila ngamandla. Nokuba amandla omlilo anyuswa aze kuqhutywe ukufaka ubushushu, kutheni isikali se-thermometer singasenyuki ngaphezu kwe-100℃?
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.s.s1.explain: Ngexesha apho ulwelo olucocekileyo lubila, amandla obushushu afakiweyo aqhawula ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli aze aguqule kwimeko yegesi (ubushushu bokuguquka-ngumphunga) asetyenziswa konke, ngoko ubushushu buhlala bulinganayo kude kube onke amanzi eguquke abe ngumphunga.

20261122-chemistry-g04-2.title: Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.material: Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo yenkqubo yotshintsho lwemeko ye-“umbethe” ocacileyo ukwiintsimbi zengca ekuseni kakhulu kunye ne-“frost” emhlophe kwiifestile okanye uphahla ebusuku bokuqala kokubusika?
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo yenkqubo yotshintsho lwemeko ye-“umbethe” ocacileyo ukwiintsimbi zengca ekuseni kakhulu kunye ne-“frost” emhlophe kwiifestile okanye uphahla ebusuku bokuqala kokubusika?
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Umbethe ngumphunga wamanzi osemoyeni odibene (uguquka ube lulwelo) emphezulwini wengca ebandayo ebusuku, ize i-frost ibe ngumphunga ovela kubushushu obungezantsi kwe-zero uguquke ngqo ube ziikristali zomkhenkce ngaphandle kokudlula kulwelo.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.hint.1: I-frost yikristali zomkhenkce ezenziwa kubushushu obungezantsi ku-zero (umphunga → isolidi).
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o0: Umbethe: umphunga wamanzi uguquka ube ngamathontsi olwelo (liquefaction) / frost: umphunga wamanzi uguquka ngqo ube ziikristali zomkhenkce (sublimation)
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o1: Umbethe: umkhenkce uyanyibilika / frost: amanzi ayabila
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o2: Umbethe kunye ne-frost zombini ngamanzi avuke abe ngumphunga
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.o.o3: Umbethe: amanzi omthombo avela emhlabeni / frost: ikhephu elisuka esibhakabhakeni
